title: Depth decreases along an edge
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices. If $v$ is not an input vertex and $v<n+|C|$, then every vertex $a$ read by the gate at index $v-n$ has strictly smaller depth than $v$.
